verdict.rationale: Limitless documents a public Developer API with user-generated API keys. It covers listing, hybrid search, fetching and deleting Lifelogs, downloading audio as Ogg Opus, and listing and deleting Ask AI chats, with stated rate limits, an example repository, and an MCP server for agent access. The API is mostly read-and-delete, so a user can query and manage data but cannot create content or trigger actions, and probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt. Missing for 10: write/create or action endpoints beyond deletion, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration of the API working.
